newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Engil wins hypermarket construction deal.
newsitem.headline: Engil wins hypermarket construction deal.

text.p: A consortium led by construction company Engil-SGPS won a 2.2 billion escudo ($14.5 million) contract for part of the building work at a new Carrefour shopping centre outside Lisbon, the company said in a statement.
The Engil statement said that construction work should begin in November and be finished in May 1997.

The contract was one of a number of new projects totalling some 4.4 billion escudos listed in the statement. Other contracts included the construction of viaducts on the Porto-Valenca motorway, worth some 1.65 billion and due to be finished by the summer of 1998.
